tools.name: search_courts
tools.description: Use this when the user wants to find places to play racquet sports (pickleball, tennis, padel, badminton, racquetball, squash, table tennis) near a location, or wants to see open court times. Typical asks: "pickleball courts near me", "where can I play tennis tonight?", "book a padel court Saturday

tools.name: get_booking_link
tools.description:
Use this when the user has picked an open court time from search_courts and wants to reserve it ("book the 6pm court", "reserve that one for 90 minutes", "lock in Saturday at 9"). Get a booking link for a court.
Requires facilityId, date, time, sportId, and duration.
Optional players (1–8, default 2

tools.name: get_facility_details
tools.description: Use this when the user asks about a specific facility: hours, address, phone number, amenities, policies, what sports it offers, or its courts. tools.name: search_lessons
tools.description: Use this when the user wants a coach or private lessons for pickleball or tennis near a location. Not for court availability (search_courts) or open play (search_open_play). Read-only: it shows the coach's open lesson tim

tools.description: Optional: use this only when the user asks to have their own details filled in on the checkout for them. Not for court availability (search_courts), open play (search_open_play) or coaching (search_lessons). Typical asks: "pickleball tournaments near me", "tennis leagues in Dallas", "any tournaments this weekend

tools.name: get_coach_profile
tools.description: The coach card calls this when someone opens a coach's profile. It is not needed to find a coach, which search_lessons does. Read-only: it returns the bio, the places, the lesson lengths and the cancellation policy. It does not return a price.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_courts, get_booking_link, get_facility_details, search_open_play, get_lesson_booking_link, search_tournaments · Private data: get_facility_details, search_lessons, get_lesson_times, get_lesson_booking_link, record_click, record_card_error · Public sink: search_courts, get_facility_details, search_open_play, search_lessons, get_lesson_times, get_lesson_booking_link, search_tournaments · Destructive: search_open_play.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_courts, get_booking_link, get_facility_details, search_open_play, get_lesson_booking_link, search_tournaments · Private data: get_facility_details, search_lessons, get_lesson_times, get_lesson_booking_link, record_click, record_card_error · Public sink: search_courts, get_facility_details, search_open_play, search_lessons, get_lesson_times, get_lesson_booking_link, search_tournaments · Destructive: search_open_play

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
